title.english: A Place at the Long Table

pairs.target: yīwén qǐng tāmen chīfàn shí , tèyì shuō búyòng huànyīfu . tǎ wéi háishì bǎ lǐngkǒu fānguò láikàn le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: When Iven invited them to dinner, he expressly said they need not change clothes. Tavi still turned his collar over to inspect it.
pairs.hanzi:
伊文请他们吃饭时，特意说不用换衣服。
塔维还是把领口翻过来看了一遍。

pairs.target: qù xuéxiào kèshè de lùshang , mǐlā wèn tā zài zhǎo shénme , tā shuō xiàntóu . tā shēnshǒu tì tā zhuài diào yìgēn , yòu tíxǐng tā fùqīn búshì lái chá qǐnshì de .
pairs.english: On the way to the school guesthouse, Mira asked what he was looking for. Loose threads, he said. She pulled one off for him and reminded him his father wasn't here to inspect the dormitory.
pairs.hanzi: 去学校客舍的路上，米拉问他在找什么，他说线头。她伸手替他拽掉一根，又提醒他父亲不是来查寝室的。

pairs.target: " yòu búshì wǒ fùqīn . " mǐlā lèng le yíxià , xiào le , shuō duì , tā yě yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng .
pairs.english: “He's not my father.” Mira paused, then laughed and said true, she was nervous too.
pairs.hanzi:
“又不是我父亲。”
米拉愣了一下，笑了，说对，她也有点紧张。

pairs.target: kèshè fàntīng bìngbúdà . liǎngzhāng chángzhuō pīnzàiyìqǐ , chuāng biān fàng zhe jǐpén yèzi luò le yíbàn de cǎo .
pairs.english: The guesthouse dining room was small. Two long tables had been joined, with pots of half-bare plants beside the window.
pairs.hanzi: 客舍饭厅并不大。两张长桌拼在一起，窗边放着几盆叶子落了一半的草。

pairs.target: yīwén de fùqīn yǐjīng dào le , wàiyī dā zài yǐbèi shàng , yìzhī xiùkǒu hái jiá zhe méi qǔ xiàlái de zhǐ qiān . tā zhàn qǐlái yíng tāmen , xiān jiào chū mǐlā de míngzì , zài wèn tǎ wéi shìbushì zuòzài ménkǒu huì lěng .
pairs.english: Iven's father was already there, his coat over a chair back, a paper tag still clipped to one cuff. Rising to welcome them, he greeted Mira by name, then asked whether Tavi would be cold beside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文的父亲已经到了，外衣搭在椅背上，一只袖口还夹着没取下来的纸签。他站起来迎他们，先叫出米拉的名字，再问塔维是不是坐在门口会冷。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō bù lěng , yīwén què bǎ tā wǎng lǐ tuī le yíwèi , shuō děng shàngcài de rén láihuí kāimén , tā jiù huì hòuhuǐ . zhuōshàng xiānduān lái de shì miànbāo hé dùncài ,
pairs.english: Tavi said no, but Iven pushed him one seat inward, saying he would regret it once servers started opening the door. Bread and stew arrived first.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维说不冷，伊文却把他往里推了一位，说等上菜的人来回开门，他就会后悔。
桌上先端来的是面包和炖菜，

pairs.target: fùqīn ná qǐ dāoqiè le liǎngxià , fāxiàn dāokǒu dùn , biàn fàngxià gǎiyòng shǒu bāi . yīwén zài pángbiān tànqì , shuō zhèlǐ zhìshǎo háiyǒu lìng yìbǎ . fùqīn shēnshǒu qù ná , cái kànjiàn jiù zài zìjǐ pán biān .
pairs.english: His father tried the knife twice, found it dull, and put it down to tear the bread by hand. Iven sighed, saying there was at least another knife. His father reached for it and only then noticed it right by his plate.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲拿起刀切了两下，发现刀口钝，便放下改用手掰。伊文在旁边叹气，说这里至少还有另一把。父亲伸手去拿，才看见就在自己盘边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuánxiān xiǎng hǎo de zuòzī sōng le yìdiǎn . tāmen liáoqǐ xiē dēng yè . fùqīn shuō yīwén xìn lǐ xiě le gǎi xì , xiǎoshíhòu nàduàn chuánfū , tā yě chàng guò , zhǐshì cónglái chàng bùzhǔn zuìhòu yíjù .
pairs.english: Tavi relaxed his carefully planned posture a little. They talked about Lights' Rest Night. His father said Iven's letter mentioned the rewritten play; he had sung that boatman passage as a child too, though never got the final line in tune.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维原先想好的坐姿松了一点。
他们聊起歇灯夜。父亲说伊文信里写了改戏，小时候那段船夫，他也唱过，只是从来唱不准最后一句。

alignment.english: never got the final line in tune

pairs.target: yīwén lìkè shuō bùzhǐ zuìhòu yíjù , fùqīn xiǎng fǎnbó , xiǎng le xiǎng , yòu rèn le .
pairs.english: Iven promptly said it wasn't only the last line. His father started to argue, thought, then conceded.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文立刻说不止最后一句，父亲想反驳，想了想，又认了。

pairs.target: mǐlā jiǎng jiǎshān kǎzhù de dìfāng , yīwén tì tā bǐhuà nàge lùchū lái de xié jiān . tǎ wéi kànzhe fùzǐliǎ tóngshí xiào , hūrán rènchū yīwén shuōhuà shí nàzhǒng xiān tái yíxià méimáo de xíguàn . yuánlái lián zhège yě yǒu lái chù .
pairs.english: Mira described the stuck fake mountain; Iven mimed the protruding shoe. Watching father and son laugh together, Tavi suddenly recognized Iven's habit of raising his eyebrows before speaking. Even that had come from somewhere.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉讲假山卡住的地方，伊文替她比画那个露出来的鞋尖。塔维看着父子俩同时笑，忽然认出伊文说话时那种先抬一下眉毛的习惯。原来连这个也有来处。

pairs.target: dùncài tiān dìèrhuí shí , fùqīn wèn tāmen zuìjìn zài xué shénme . mǐlā shuō dào qiáo zuò tú , tā biàn wèn shìbushì jiù gōng chénlièshì nà yìpī .
pairs.english: During second helpings of stew, his father asked what they were studying. Mira mentioned bridge-base drawings; he asked if they were from the old-works collection.
pairs.hanzi: 炖菜添第二回时，父亲问他们最近在学什么。米拉说到桥座图，他便问是不是旧工陈列室那一批。

alignment.english: they were from the old-works collection

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn yǐwéi tā yào zhuǎntóu wèn zìjǐ chéngjì , méixiǎngdào tā zhuīwèn de shì nà zhī tiěhuán yǒuméiyǒu chóngxīn bān guò wèizhì . " nǐ yě kànguò ? " tǎ wéi wèn . " niánqīng shíhòu . nà shíhòu mén hái méi bǔ hǎo , jìnqù yìgǔ lěngfēng . "
pairs.english: Tavi expected him to turn and ask about his marks, but instead he asked if the iron ring had been moved again. “You've seen it too?” Tavi asked. “When I was young. The doorway wasn't repaired then; a cold draft hit you as you entered.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维本以为他要转头问自己成绩，没想到他追问的是那只铁环有没有重新搬过位置。
“你也看过？”塔维问。
“年轻时候。那时候门还没补好，进去一股冷风。”

pairs.target: yīwén shuō tā cóngméi tīng guò zhège . fùqīn dádào , nǐ yǐqián zhī kěn tīng wǒ zài lùshang chī guò shénme . yīwén xiǎng le xiǎng , shuō zhège wèntí dào xiànzài yě méi shīqù yìyì .
pairs.english: Iven said he had never heard this story. His father said, before you only wanted to hear what I ate while traveling. Iven considered and said the question remained worthwhile even now.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说他从没听过这个。父亲答道，你以前只肯听我在路上吃过什么。伊文想了想，说这个问题到现在也没失去意义。

pairs.target: chī dào hòulái , fùqīn cóng suíshēn de jiá cè lǐ qǔchū yìzhāng xiǎolù tú , yā zài gānjìng de zhuō jiǎo . tā běnlái zhī xiǎng gěi yīwén kàn zìjǐ zhè jǐtiān yào qù nǎér , mǐlā rènchū běi chà , shēntǐ biàn wǎngqián qīng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Later in the meal, his father took a small route map from his folder and spread it on a clean table corner. He meant only to show Iven where he would go these days, but Mira leaned forward on recognizing Northfork.
pairs.hanzi: 吃到后来，父亲从随身的夹册里取出一张小路图，压在干净的桌角。他本来只想给伊文看自己这几天要去哪儿，米拉认出北汊，身体便往前倾了一点。

pairs.target: tú shàng yǒu liǎngtiáo ràoxíng de xiàn . yìtiáo cháng , jīngguò xiànchéng de lù zhàn ; lìng yìtiáo shùnhé , duǎn yìxiē , jǐduàn dìfāng zhǐyǒu dāngdì tiāodàn de rén zǒu .
pairs.english: Two detours were marked. One was long and passed existing road stations; the shorter one followed the river, with sections used only by local people carrying loads on shoulder poles.
pairs.hanzi: 图上有两条绕行的线。一条长，经过现成的路站；另一条顺河，短一些，几段地方只有当地挑担的人走。

pairs.target: dōngjì huòchē yào gǎidào , yùnliáng de shāngduì cuī zhe xiānchá duǎnlù , kě nàbiān de qiáo hé luòjiǎochù dōu dé chóngxīn hé .
pairs.english: Winter freight carts needed a diversion. Grain caravans pressed for the short route to be inspected first, but its bridges and stopping places all required fresh checks.
pairs.hanzi: 冬季货车要改道，运粮的商队催着先查短路，可那边的桥和落脚处都得重新核。

pairs.target: " xiān kàn nǎtiáo ? " mǐlā wèn . " míngtiān háiyào tán . xiān bǎ jiù jìlù bǎiqí , bié ràng liǎngbiān ná zhe bùtóng niánfèn de tú chǎo . "
pairs.english: “Which route first?” Mira asked. “Still to discuss tomorrow. First assemble the old records, so the two sides aren't arguing from maps of different years.”
pairs.hanzi:
“先看哪条？”米拉问。
“明天还要谈。先把旧记录摆齐，别让两边拿着不同年份的图吵。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngdào chénlièshì qiángshàng de huī xiàn , wèn nàxiē xiǎolù yǐhòu shìbushì jiù bú huà le . fùqīn tái yǎnkàn tā , shǒulǐ de miànbāo tíng le yíxià . " wèishénme bú huà ? " " bùnéng zǒu huòchē . "
pairs.english: Remembering the gray lines on the collection wall, Tavi asked whether those little paths would stop being drawn. His father looked up at him, the bread pausing in his hand. “Why would they?” “Freight carts can't use them.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维想到陈列室墙上的灰线，问那些小路以后是不是就不画了。
父亲抬眼看他，手里的面包停了一下。
“为什么不画？”
“不能走货车。”

pairs.target: " bùnéng zǒu huòchē , bù děngyú méi rén zǒu . " tā shuō , " dàn huà zài tóng yìzhāng tú shàng , dé ràng yòng de rén kàndéchū qūbié . yǒurén zhī kàn cūxiàn , gǎnzhe zǒu , chū liǎo shì yòu shuō tú shàng méiyǒu lán . "
pairs.english: “Not fit for freight carts doesn't mean no one walks there,” he said. “But on the same map, users need to see the difference. Some only see a thick line, hurry along, and afterward say the map never barred them.”
pairs.hanzi: “不能走货车，不等于没人走。”他说，“但画在同一张图上，得让用的人看得出区别。有人只看粗线，赶着走，出了事又说图上没有拦。”

pairs.target: yīwén wèn néng bunéng bǎ dāngdìrén de jiàofǎ yě xiě shàng . fùqīn shuō kěyǐ lìng liè , yǎnxià zuì máfán de shì tóng yízuò qiáo yǒu sāngè míngzì , chāo de rén yǐwéi yǒu sānzuò .
pairs.english: Iven asked if local names could be included too. His father said they could be listed separately. The worst problem just now was one bridge having three names, which copyists took for three bridges.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文问能不能把当地人的叫法也写上。父亲说可以另列，眼下最麻烦的是同一座桥有三个名字，抄的人以为有三座。

pairs.target: tā dàilái liǎngběn jìlù , hái quē yíyè qùnián de dùkǒu qīngdān , míngzǎo qù zhǎo . tā shuō zhèxiē shí yǔsù kuài le , shǒuzhǐ zài zhuōshàng diǎnzháo .
pairs.english: He had brought two record books and still lacked one page of last year's ferry list; he would fetch it tomorrow morning. As he spoke he quickened, fingers tapping the table.
pairs.hanzi:
他带来两本记录，还缺一页去年的渡口清单，明早去找。
他说这些时语速快了，手指在桌上点着。

pairs.target: yīwén yě ná qǐ qiānbǐ , liǎnggè rén wèndá qǐlái , xiàng hūrán zǒu dào le tǎ wéi hái bù shúxī de yíduàn lùshang . mǐlā néng gēnshàng , wèn qiáomiàn de kuāndù shìbushì dōu xiě le .
pairs.english: Iven picked up a pencil too, and their questions and answers seemed to enter a stretch of road unfamiliar to Tavi. Mira kept up, asking whether all bridge widths were listed.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文也拿起铅笔，两个人问答起来，像忽然走到了塔维还不熟悉的一段路上。米拉能跟上，问桥面的宽度是不是都写了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi zài chāhuà , dītóu bǎ pán lǐ zuìhòu yíkuài luóbo chīdiào . fùqīn tíngxiàlái cái fāxiànzìjǐ shuō dé tài duō , bǎ tú wǎng huíshōu , wèn tāmen yào buyào tiánbǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi said no more, lowering his head to eat the last piece of radish. Only when his father stopped did he realize he had talked too much; he drew back the map and offered sweet biscuits.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维没再插话，低头把盘里最后一块萝卜吃掉。
父亲停下来才发现自己说得太多，把图往回收，问他们要不要甜饼。

pairs.target: yīwén què ànzhù yìjiǎo , wèn téng tú shì zài shénme shíhòu . " dàhòutiān qǐ , liǎngtiān xiàwǔ . xuéxiào zhèbiān jiè le jiān wūzi , dōu shì néng gōngkāi gěi yùnhuò rén kàn de dǐtú .
pairs.english: But Iven held down a corner and asked when the copying was. “Starting three days from now, two afternoons. The school has lent us a room. All public base maps for freight haulers.”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文却按住一角，问誊图是在什么时候。
“大后天起，两天下午。学校这边借了间屋子，都是能公开给运货人看的底图。

pairs.target: nǐ yàoshi méi kè , kěyǐ lái zuò gè fùběn , yuánjiàn yǒurén hé . " yīwén shuō tā xiǎng shìshì . " nǐ xiěxìn shuō de héchàng ne ? " " wǎnshàng liàn , bù chōngtū . "
pairs.english: “If you're free of class, you can make a copy. Someone checks it against the original.” Iven said he wanted to try. “What about the choir you mentioned in your letter?” “Evening practice. No conflict.”
pairs.hanzi:
你要是没课，可以来做个副本，原件有人核。”
伊文说他想试试。
“你写信说的合唱呢？”
“晚上练，不冲突。”

pairs.target: fùqīn diǎndiǎntóu , shuō nà míngtiān bǎ shíjiān sònglái . tā méi yāoqiú yīwén dāngchǎng bǎozhèng shénme , xiān qù jiào rén tiān bǐng .
pairs.english: His father nodded and said he would send the times tomorrow. Without demanding any promise from Iven then and there, he went to ask for more biscuits.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲点点头，说那明天把时间送来。他没要求伊文当场保证什么，先去叫人添饼。

pairs.target: yīwén shōuqǐ qiānbǐ , fāxiàn tǎ wéi zhèng kànzhe zìjǐ , biàn xiào le yíxià , shuō zhǐshì chāo tú , yòu búshì yào bǎ tā dàizǒu .
pairs.english: Putting his pencil away, Iven noticed Tavi watching him and smiled. It was only copying maps, he said, not taking him away.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文收起铅笔，发现塔维正看着自己，便笑了一下，说只是抄图，又不是要把他带走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě xiào le , méi wèn yuē hǎo qù chénlièshì de nàtiān zěnmebàn . tāmen gāngcái shuō de shì liǎngtiān xiàwǔ , tā zài xīnlǐ shù le shù , shù dào zuìhòu yìtiān , zhènghǎo pèngshàng yuánxiān quān zài mínglù shàng de rìzi .
pairs.english: Tavi smiled too, without asking about their promised collection visit. They had said two afternoons; counting in his head, he found the final day coincided with the date circled in the catalog.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也笑了，没问约好去陈列室的那天怎么办。他们刚才说的是两天下午，他在心里数了数，数到最后一天，正好碰上原先圈在名录上的日子。

pairs.target: sànxí shí , fùqīn bǎ sān rén sòngdào láng xià , dīngzhǔ yīwén bié bǎ jièlái de bǐ dàihuí qǐnshì . yīwén cóng xiùkǒu mō chū nà zhī bǐ , zìjǐ yě xiào .
pairs.english: After dinner his father saw them to the porch, reminding Iven not to take the borrowed pencil to his room. Finding it in his cuff, Iven laughed too.
pairs.hanzi: 散席时，父亲把三人送到廊下，叮嘱伊文别把借来的笔带回寝室。伊文从袖口摸出那支笔，自己也笑。

pairs.target: mǐ lāzǒu zài qiánmiàn , wèn tiánbǐng shìbushì yǒu chéngpí . tǎ wéi shuō yǒu . nà wèidào hái zài shégēn , hěndàn , yì xīqì jiù yòu wén dédào .
pairs.english: Ahead, Mira asked if the biscuits had orange peel. Tavi said yes. The faint flavor remained on his tongue, returning with each breath.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉走在前面，问甜饼是不是有橙皮。
塔维说有。那味道还在舌根，很淡，一吸气就又闻得到。

pairs.target: tā huítóu kàn le yìyǎn , yīwén zhèng bǎ kèshè mén dàishàng , dēng cóng ménfèng lǐ shōuchéng yìtiáoxiàn , zuìhòu luò zài tā de xié biān .
pairs.english: He looked back once. Iven was closing the guesthouse door; light narrowed to a line in the crack, then fell beside his shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 他回头看了一眼，伊文正把客舍门带上，灯从门缝里收成一条线，最后落在他的鞋边。
